notes: Deterministic craft defaults for puzzle / coloring / journal / printable products, resolved by audience x book_type. Experts (this config + age_bands.json) decide craft; humans do not pick these per product. Colour is single-sourced from publishing_house.project.default_colour_policy and may only be RAISED by a colour-carrying book_type.

trim_catalog.8.5x11: US Letter: dominant trim for puzzle/activity/coloring/workbook interiors and printables.
trim_catalog.8x10: Slightly smaller activity trim; good for children's coloring/activity.
trim_catalog.6x9: Compact trim for text-forward journals, logic collections, and travel puzzle books.
trim_catalog.7x10: Mid trim for guided journals and planners.
trim_catalog.8.25x8.25: Square trim favoured by children's coloring/activity books.

kids-4-8.rationale: Youngest activity/coloring audience: large art, few elements per page, big type, forgiving difficulty progression.

kids-6-10.rationale: Early-elementary activity audience: clear grids, moderate element counts, easy-to-medium ramp.

tween-8-12.rationale: Upper-elementary/tween: denser puzzles, black-and-white grids, colour only on dedicated art pages.

teen-13-17.rationale: Teen audience: standard adult grids, black-and-white interior, mixed difficulty.

adult-general.rationale: General adult puzzle/journal: black-and-white interior standard; colour only where the product family requires it.

senior-large-print.rationale: Large-print accessibility band: large grids and type, high contrast, low density, black-and-white to preserve contrast.

puzzle-book.rationale: Puzzle books lead with grids and solvability; difficulty progresses front-to-back, solutions grouped back-only.

activity-book.rationale: Activity books mix puzzle types and light art; higher element density per spread.

coloring-book.rationale: Coloring books are low-ink single-sided line art (originals only); the interior is line art the reader colours, so it stays black-and-white line work.

guided-journal.rationale: Guided journals are text-and-prompt forward with generous writing space; smaller trims read as a personal journal.

workbook.rationale: Workbooks scaffold exercises with worked space and progressive difficulty.

planner.rationale: Planners are grid/calendar forward with functional layout and consistent recurring templates.

digital-printable.rationale: Digital printables target home printing (US Letter/A4) at >=300 DPI; sold as instant downloads on Etsy/Gumroad.
